WITH per AS (
  SELECT member_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS n_join, count(DISTINCT home_store_id) AS n_home, min(join_date) AS jd, min(valid_from) AS first_vf
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT count(*) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN n_join>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_join, sum(CASE WHEN n_home>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_home, sum(CASE WHEN first_vf<>jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_vf_ne_join, sum(CASE WHEN year(jd)=2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_2025, sum(CASE WHEN year(jd)=2025 AND n_home>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS j25_multihome
FROM per

calls.statement: SELECT year(join_date) AS y, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN member_id END) AS orphan_home, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN member_id END) AS online, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN home_store_id=999 THEN member_id END) AS training FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT month(join_date) AS m, count(*) AS joiners, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS days, max(c) AS max_per_day FROM (SELECT member_id, join_date, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY join_date) AS c FROM (SELECT DISTINCT member_id, join_date FROM dim_member WHERE year(join_date)=2025)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH j AS (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE year(join_date)=2025 GROUP BY member_id HAVING count(DISTINCT home_store_id)>1)
SELECT m.member_id, m.join_date, m.tier, m.home_store_id, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.is_current FROM dim_member m JOIN j USING (member_id) WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM j LIMIT 6) ORDER BY m.member_id, m.valid_from

WITH signup AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
),
signup_2025 AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM signup
  WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) AS new_members
FROM signup_2025 m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id
